origin: 技能原创整理，参考用户提供的风格选择截图命名，未生成实测

usage.image: 替换槽位后，将image_prompt_en作为关键帧的风格与画面基础；继续补充人物身份、构图、光源、静态姿态和画幅。
usage.video: 替换槽位后，将video_prompt_zh放在素材映射之后；继续补充连续时间轴、声音、末态与保持项。
usage.rule: 只选一个主预设。跨类混合时只添加一个次风格，并明确它只控制色彩、材质或线条中的一个维度。

placeholders.subject: 主体身份与稳定外观
placeholders.action: 视频中的可见动作过程
placeholders.sound: 对白、环境声、动作声和音乐
placeholders.end_state: 动作完成后的可观察末态

categories.name: 真人写实
categories.description: 以可信真人、实景、服化道和摄影光线为基础。用户两张截图识别到的风格均归入本类。

presets.name: 人像写实
presets.image_prompt_en: Photorealistic live-action portrait of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Natural skin texture, anatomically consistent hands, realistic hair strands and fabric, restrained color, {lighting}. One coherent still moment, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: {subject}位于{scene}，保持{pose}与{composition}；真实皮肤、头发和衣料，光线为{lighting}，只描述一个静止瞬间。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 真人写实，保持人物五官、发型、服装和空间比例。{action}；摄影机{camera}；光线保持{lighting}；声音为{sound}；结束于{end_state}。避免磨皮、五官漂移和手指变形。

presets.name: 古风写实
presets.image_prompt_en: Photorealistic historical Chinese live-action still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Historically coherent layered garments, natural cloth weight, restrained hair ornaments, weathered architecture, {lighting}, no modern objects, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 古风真人实拍观感；{subject}在{scene}中保持{pose}，服饰层次、材质重量和建筑依据统一，构图为{composition}，光线为{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 古风写实，锁定服饰层数、发髻、道具与建筑方向。{action}；摄影机{camera}；衣袖和发丝只随真实动作与环境轻微响应；声音为{sound}；末态{end_state}。不加入现代物件。

presets.name: 现代都市
presets.image_prompt_en: Contemporary live-action cinematic still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Credible modern wardrobe, real street or interior depth, practical urban light, subtle reflections, {lighting}, natural documentary detail, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 现代都市真人画面；{subject}在{scene}中保持{pose}，真实城市纵深、生活化服装与实用光，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 现代都市写实，保持人物、街道或室内地标不漂移。{action}；摄影机{camera}；城市环境运动与主体动作分层；声音为{sound}；结束于{end_state}。

presets.name: 玄幻修仙
presets.image_prompt_en: Photorealistic Chinese xianxia live-action still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Tangible layered robes, grounded terrain, atmospheric depth, one controlled supernatural motif, {lighting}, realistic face and material response, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 玄幻修仙真人观感；{subject}在{scene}中保持{pose}，服装与地面有重量，只保留一个有叙事作用的超自然元素，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 写实仙侠，人物动作先遵守重心与空间关系。{action}；摄影机{camera}；特效只响应明确触发，不遮挡脸和手；声音为{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 悬疑恐怖
presets.image_prompt_en: Grounded live-action suspense still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Restricted viewpoint, readable negative space, practical motivated shadows, subdued palette, {lighting}, tension from occlusion rather than gore, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 写实悬疑；{subject}在{scene}中保持{pose}，用受限视点、遮挡和负空间控制信息，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 悬疑写实，不新增原文没有的怪物或犯罪事实。{action}；摄影机{camera}；声音{sound}先后关系清楚；保持阴影来源和空间方向；结束于{end_state}。

presets.name: 国风古典
presets.image_prompt_en: Elegant Chinese classical live-action still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Refined but plausible costume, balanced architecture and garden layers, restrained mineral-inspired palette, {lighting}, tactile silk, wood and stone, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 国风古典真人画面；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，建筑、园林、衣料与器物层次平衡，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 国风古典，动作克制且对象明确。{action}；摄影机{camera}；保持衣纹、器物和庭院方向；声音为{sound}；末态{end_state}。不以慢动作代替内容。

presets.name: 年代剧
presets.image_prompt_en: Period live-action drama still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Era-coherent everyday wardrobe, used furniture and practical objects, natural lived-in texture, {lighting}, restrained film color, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 年代剧写实；{subject}在{scene}中保持{pose}，服装、家具和生活物件属于同一年代，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 年代剧表演克制，先保持年代物件、人物站位和道具归属。{action}；摄影机{camera}；声音为{sound}；结束于{end_state}。

presets.name: 伪纪录片
presets.image_prompt_en: Observational mockumentary live-action still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Available practical light, credible imperfect framing, environmental context, natural skin and wardrobe, {lighting}, no staged glamour, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 伪纪录片观察感；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，保留环境上下文和轻微非完美构图，光线{lighting}，不等于随意低质。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 伪纪录片观察，摄影机只因人物或信息变化而{camera}。完整记录{action}；保留现场声{sound}；不预演夸张表情；结束于{end_state}。

presets.name: 古风武侠
presets.image_prompt_en: Grounded Chinese wuxia live-action still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Readable fighting stance, practical layered costume, clear weapon ownership and terrain, wind with physical cause, {lighting}, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 古风武侠真人画面；{subject}在{scene}中保持可读的{pose}，兵器归属、脚下地形和服装层次明确，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 写实武侠，动作按预备、发力、接触与停稳组织。{action}；摄影机{camera}；兵器不复制、不穿身；声音为{sound}；结束于{end_state}。

presets.name: 邵氏电影
presets.image_prompt_en: 1970s Hong Kong studio wuxia-inspired live-action still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Deliberate theatrical set, saturated period color, hard studio key and painted depth, visible practical staging, {lighting}, subtle film grain, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 七十年代香港棚拍武侠观感；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，舞台化布景、饱和彩色与硬棚灯有意统一，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 复古棚拍武侠，动作轮廓优先。{action}；摄影机采用{camera}；布景和灯位保持舞台逻辑；声音为{sound}；末态{end_state}。只提炼技法，不复制具体影片角色。

presets.name: 民国剧
presets.image_prompt_en: Republican-era Chinese live-action drama still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Era-coherent tailoring, restrained interior decoration, weathered street or residence, {lighting}, muted photographic palette, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 民国剧真人写实；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，西装、旗袍或长衫需与具体身份相符，陈设和街景同年代，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 民国剧写实，保持服装版型、人物礼仪、道具和空间关系。{action}；摄影机{camera}；声音{sound}；结束于{end_state}。

presets.name: 暗黑哥特
presets.image_prompt_en: Live-action dark Gothic still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Tall architectural rhythm, aged stone and dark textile, controlled candle or window light, deep readable shadows, {lighting}, restrained crimson accent, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 暗黑哥特真人画面；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，高耸结构、旧石材和深色织物统一，暗部仍可读，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 哥特写实，恐惧来自空间、声音和行为，不默认超自然。{action}；摄影机{camera}；烛火或窗光方向稳定；声音为{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 中式华丽
presets.image_prompt_en: Opulent Chinese live-action costume still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Intricate but coherent embroidery, controlled jewel tones, lacquered wood and metal details, hierarchy of ornament, {lighting}, face and hands remain readable, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 中式华丽真人画面；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，刺绣、漆木和金属细节有层级，不让装饰压过动作，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 中式华丽，锁定纹样位置、首饰数量和服装层次。{action}；摄影机{camera}；材质随动作产生有限高光；声音为{sound}；结束于{end_state}。

presets.name: 古代战场
presets.image_prompt_en: Grounded ancient battlefield live-action still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Clear terrain, unit direction and weapon ownership, worn armor materials, controlled dust with visible source, {lighting}, readable foreground action and distant scale, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 古代战场真人写实；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，地形、阵列方向、兵器归属和盔甲材质可读，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 古战场镜头先锁定主角、友军方向和地标。{action}；摄影机{camera}；尘土只由脚步、马匹或撞击触发；声音为{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 未来科幻
presets.image_prompt_en: Photorealistic live-action science-fiction still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Functional future technology, coherent interfaces and materials, clear human scale, practical motivated {lighting}, restrained atmosphere, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 未来科幻真人写实；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，未来设备有明确功能、尺度和材质，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 写实未来科幻，锁定设备结构、界面位置和空间尺度。{action}；摄影机{camera}；灯光或机械响应有明确触发；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 中式梦境
presets.image_prompt_en: Photorealistic Chinese dreamscape still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Familiar Chinese spatial motifs transformed by one coherent dream rule, soft atmospheric depth, restrained symbolic color, {lighting}, tangible face and fabric, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 中式梦境真人画面；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，只采用一个清楚梦境规则改变空间，人物和衣料仍有实体感，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 中式梦境，先保持人物身份、动作与主要地标。{action}；摄影机{camera}；梦境变化只由指定触发发生；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 中世纪奇幻
presets.image_prompt_en: Photorealistic medieval fantasy live-action still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Grounded stone, timber, leather and metal, coherent costume layers, one controlled magical element, {lighting}, readable terrain and scale, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 中世纪奇幻真人写实；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，石、木、皮革和金属材质可信，只保留一个魔法重点，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 中世纪奇幻写实，人物、武器和地形遵守重量与接触。{action}；摄影机{camera}；魔法只响应明确触发；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 惊悚压抑
presets.image_prompt_en: Oppressive psychological thriller live-action still of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Compressed spatial layers, controlled off-balance framing, low practical ceiling light, muted color, {lighting}, face and action remain readable, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 惊悚压抑真人画面；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，压缩空间层次和轻微失衡构图制造压力，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 心理惊悚，压迫感来自空间距离、等待和声场，不新增怪物。{action}；摄影机{camera}；声音{sound}；保持可读暗部；结束于{end_state}。

categories.name: 3D动画
categories.description: 以三维造型、材质、灯光、重量和接触关系组织画面。

presets.name: 写实三维电影
presets.image_prompt_en: Cinematic realistic 3D render of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Stable model proportions, physically plausible materials, grounded contact shadows, {lighting}, detailed but uncluttered environment, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 写实三维；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，模型比例、接触影和材质尺度稳定，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 写实三维电影，先保持模型、材质和碰撞体。{action}；摄影机{camera}；运动体现重量与减速；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 风格化角色三维
presets.image_prompt_en: Stylized 3D character frame of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Consistent head-to-body ratio, simplified expressive shapes, controlled material roughness, readable hands and silhouette, {lighting}, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 风格化三维角色；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，头身比、发束和服装色块固定，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 风格化角色三维，姿态和视线先于夸张表情。{action}；摄影机{camera}；保持头身比和手部目标；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 低多边形
presets.image_prompt_en: Low-poly 3D scene of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Intentional angular geometry, limited color palette, stable face density, crisp silhouette, simple directional {lighting}, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 低多边形三维；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，块面密度和限定色板一致，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 低多边形风格，块面数量和色板不随时间变化。{action}；摄影机{camera}；脚与地面接触清楚；声音{sound}；结束于{end_state}。

presets.name: 微缩玩具
presets.image_prompt_en: Miniature toy-world 3D frame of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Consistent scale cues, tactile wood, fabric or painted resin, tabletop contact, soft studio {lighting}, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 微缩玩具三维；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，玩偶、道具和台景比例明确，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 微缩玩具世界，动作幅度符合短肢体和小道具重量。{action}；摄影机{camera}；保持比例与接触；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

categories.name: 二次元
categories.description: 以线稿、色块、赛璐璐阴影和姿态关键点组织二维动画。

presets.name: 清新青春
presets.image_prompt_en: Hand-drawn 2D cel anime frame of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Clean line art, stable facial design, two-step soft cel shading, fresh restrained palette, layered painted background, {lighting}, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 清新二维；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，线稿、五官设计和服装色块稳定，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 清新二次元，保持线稿粗细、色阶和背景地标。{action}；画面层或镜头{camera}；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 热血动作
presets.image_prompt_en: Dynamic hand-drawn 2D cel action frame of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Strong readable silhouette, clear center of gravity, angular shadows, controlled foreshortening, no speed lines before motion, {lighting}, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 热血二维动作；{subject}在{scene}保持明确重心的{pose}，动作轮廓和落点可读，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 热血二维，按预备、爆发、接触、缓冲和停稳组织{action}；镜头{camera}；速度线仅在高速阶段出现；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 复古赛璐璐
presets.image_prompt_en: Retro hand-painted cel anime frame of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Limited color steps, stable dark outlines, hand-painted background, subtle analog grain, {lighting}, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 复古赛璐璐；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，有限色阶、稳定轮廓和手绘背景，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 复古手绘二维，姿态阶段清楚，不用抖动冒充手绘。{action}；画面{camera}；声音{sound}；结束于{end_state}。

presets.name: 漫画图形
presets.image_prompt_en: Single-panel graphic comic illustration of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Bold black shapes, controlled halftone, crisp silhouette, deliberate negative space, {lighting}, no text or extra panels, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 单幅图形漫画；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，黑色块、网点和负空间服务信息，构图{composition}，无文字分格。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 漫画图形风格，以姿态和构图切换完成{action}；镜头或画面层{camera}；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}；文字交给后期。

categories.name: 摄影艺术
categories.description: 以真实摄影媒介为基础，强调胶片、光线、曝光、镜头距离和暗房语言。

presets.name: 胶片纪实
presets.image_prompt_en: Documentary 35mm film photograph of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Available light, candid spatial context, restrained grain, gentle highlight roll-off, realistic color response, {lighting}, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 35毫米胶片纪实；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，环境上下文和自然曝光优先，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。

presets.image_prompt_zh: 黑白艺术摄影；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，中间调、暗部层次和材质可读，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 黑白摄影艺术，亮度关系不跳变。{action}；摄影机{camera}；保持主体与背景分离；声音{sound}；结束于{end_state}。

presets.name: 低调光编辑摄影
presets.image_prompt_en: Low-key editorial photograph of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. One motivated key light, negative fill, controlled specular detail, deep readable background, {lighting}, elegant restrained color, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 低调光编辑摄影；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，主光和负补光明确，暗部仍可读，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 低调光摄影，人物或产品移动时保持主光方向。{action}；摄影机{camera}；高光不漂移；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 梦幻长曝光
presets.image_prompt_en: Dreamlike long-exposure fine-art photograph of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Main subject retains one sharp identity anchor, selected environmental light trails show time, controlled motion blur, {lighting}, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 梦幻长曝光；{subject}在{scene}保持一个清晰身份锚点，只有指定环境运动形成光轨或拖影，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 长曝光摄影意象仅控制光轨和环境残影，主体动作仍清楚。{action}；摄影机{camera}；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

categories.name: 插画艺术
categories.description: 以数字绘画、编辑插画、概念设计和图形语言组织单幅与动画。

presets.name: 编辑插画
presets.image_prompt_en: Editorial illustration of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Clear visual metaphor grounded in the supplied text, simplified shapes, controlled palette, strong hierarchy, {lighting}, no invented claims, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 编辑插画；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，图形隐喻必须来自原文，构图{composition}，色彩与光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 编辑插画动画，只让与信息有关的层移动。{action}；画面层{camera}；声音{sound}；结束于{end_state}；不新增事实。

presets.name: 绘本插画
presets.image_prompt_en: Painterly storybook illustration of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Simplified expressive forms, layered environment, warm paper texture, coherent limited palette, {lighting}, readable path and landmarks, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 绘本插画；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，角色轮廓、路径与地标清楚，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 绘本动画，角色真实走动，背景分层移动。{action}；画面{camera}；声音{sound}；结束于{end_state}。

presets.name: 电影概念插画
presets.image_prompt_en: Cinematic concept illustration of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Functional environment design, clear scale anchors, atmospheric depth, controlled focal hierarchy, {lighting}, production-ready shape language, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 电影概念插画；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，空间功能、尺度锚点和地标可执行，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 概念插画动态化时保持建筑、路径和尺度。{action}；摄影机或画面层{camera}；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 矢量图形插画
presets.image_prompt_en: Flat vector-style illustration of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Crisp geometric shapes, limited palette, consistent stroke system, clear negative space, {lighting}, no gradients unless specified, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 矢量图形插画；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，几何形、描边体系和负空间统一，构图{composition}，色光{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 矢量图形动画，每个形状有明确路径和终点。{action}；画面{camera}；声音{sound}；结束于{end_state}。

categories.name: 朋克艺术
categories.description: 按技术系统、材料和社会空间区分朋克类型，不只叠加霓虹。

presets.name: 赛博朋克
presets.image_prompt_en: Grounded cyberpunk visual of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Dense but legible urban infrastructure, practical neon signage as light sources, worn high-tech materials, wet surfaces only if specified, {lighting}, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 赛博朋克；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，高技术与生活磨损并存，霓虹必须有光源，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 赛博朋克，保持街区地理、设备功能和人物身份。{action}；摄影机{camera}；广告光只影响相应表面；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 蒸汽朋克
presets.image_prompt_en: Steampunk visual of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Functional brass, iron, leather and pressure systems, visible mechanical joints, restrained Victorian-inspired tailoring, motivated warm {lighting}, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 蒸汽朋克；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，黄铜、钢铁、皮革和压力机构有功能关系，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 蒸汽朋克，机械运动沿轴、齿轮或活塞传递。{action}；摄影机{camera}；蒸汽由阀门或压力释放触发；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 柴油朋克
presets.image_prompt_en: Dieselpunk visual of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Heavy riveted machinery, oil-stained steel, analog instruments, aerodynamic interwar forms, smoky industrial {lighting} with readable silhouettes, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 柴油朋克；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，铆接钢板、模拟仪表和重型机械统一，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 柴油朋克，动作体现设备重量和机械惯性。{action}；摄影机{camera}；烟只来自排气或工业源；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 太阳朋克
presets.image_prompt_en: Solarpunk visual of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Climate-adapted architecture, visible renewable systems, integrated vegetation with maintenance logic, bright natural {lighting}, humane public space, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 太阳朋克；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，可再生能源、遮阳、通风与植物维护逻辑可见，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 太阳朋克，环境系统按风、光、水或人流响应。{action}；摄影机{camera}；植物不无因疯长；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

categories.name: 传统美术
categories.description: 以具体画种的材料、笔法、空间和色彩规则转译镜头。

presets.name: 水墨留白
presets.image_prompt_en: Chinese ink-wash painting of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Warm rice paper, dry and wet brush hierarchy, three ink densities, deliberate blank space, clear subject contour, {lighting} translated into ink value, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 水墨留白；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，宣纸、干湿笔和三层墨色组织空间，构图{composition}，光线转为{lighting}的墨色关系。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 水墨动态只让指定水面、云气或笔触变化，主体轮廓不溶化。{action}；画面{camera}；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 工笔设色
presets.image_prompt_en: Chinese gongbi fine-line painting of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Controlled fine outlines, layered mineral colors, stable textile and object patterns, planar depth, {lighting} translated into restrained tonal layering, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 工笔设色；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，细线、层染、衣纹和器物形制稳定，构图{composition}，光线转为{lighting}的色层。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 工笔动态克制，线条与纹样不随动作游走。{action}；画面{camera}；声音{sound}；结束于{end_state}。

presets.name: 敦煌壁画
presets.image_prompt_en: Dunhuang mural-inspired illustration of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Mineral pigment palette, aged plaster texture, rhythmic contour lines, flattened sacred spatial order, restrained decorative clouds, {lighting} expressed through color hierarchy, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 敦煌壁画技法启发；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，矿物色、旧壁肌理、线描节奏和平面秩序统一，构图{composition}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 壁画动态保持平面色层与线描，动作沿既定姿态路径发生。{action}；画面{camera}；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。尊重文化语境，不随意拼贴宗教符号。

presets.name: 木版画
presets.image_prompt_en: Traditional woodblock print of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Carved line rhythm, limited registered colors, visible paper grain, bold silhouette, intentional flat overlap, {lighting} expressed as carved value shapes, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 木版画；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，刻线节奏、套色和纸纹稳定，构图{composition}，光线转为{lighting}的明暗块。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 木版画动态保持套色和刻线配准。{action}；画面层{camera}；声音{sound}；结束于{end_state}。

categories.name: 工艺美术
categories.description: 以纸、黏土、纤维、漆、金属和陶瓷等具体材料及工艺限制设计画面。

presets.name: 剪纸层叠
presets.image_prompt_en: Layered paper-cut craft scene of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Visible paper thickness, clean cut edges, stable layer order, soft cast shadows, limited colored paper palette, {lighting}, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 剪纸层叠；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，纸张厚度、切边和层次顺序清楚，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 剪纸动画只按纸片滑移、铰接或层间位移。{action}；画面{camera}；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 黏土定格
presets.image_prompt_en: Clay stop-motion-style craft scene of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Stable puppet proportions, tactile fingerprints, miniature set scale, grounded feet and props, soft studio {lighting}, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 黏土定格质感；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，偶形比例、指压痕和台景尺度稳定，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 黏土定格观感，姿态分步变化，只有指定软材料变形。{action}；摄影机{camera}；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。

presets.name: 刺绣纤维
presets.image_prompt_en: Embroidery textile artwork of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Visible thread direction, layered stitches, woven fabric ground, controlled thread sheen, clear stitched contours, {lighting}, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 刺绣纤维画面；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，针脚方向、线层和织物底稳定，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 刺绣风格动态保持针脚贴合形体，不让线头随机生长。{action}；画面层{camera}；声音{sound}；结束于{end_state}。

presets.name: 景泰蓝
presets.image_prompt_en: Cloisonne enamel craft artwork of {subject} in {scene}, {pose}, {composition}. Fine metal-wire cells, luminous enamel colors, controlled gold outlines, polished but material-specific reflections, {lighting}, aspect ratio {aspect_ratio}.
presets.image_prompt_zh: 景泰蓝工艺；{subject}在{scene}保持{pose}，掐丝边界、珐琅色块和金属反射有工艺逻辑，构图{composition}，光线{lighting}。
presets.video_prompt_zh: 景泰蓝风格，掐丝边界与珐琅分区锁定。{action}；摄影机或画面{camera}；高光随角度有限移动；声音{sound}；末态{end_state}。
